annotations.title: Rename an app or change its address

description: Change what BugOtter calls an app, or the URL it checks (after a domain move, instead of adding a second app). History, issues and settings stay; SSL and domain expiry are looked up again and the first check of the new URL runs right away. The page address (slug) never changes. Needs write access.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.
